description: Shiori: a bookmark manager with readable offline archives, a web UI, a REST API and a CLI, on SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.

listmonk: a self-hosted newsletter and mailing-list manager with campaigns, templates, subscriber lists and an API, on a bundled PostgreSQL, with the schema and first administrator set up at install. Hardened by QuenchWorks, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
